name: Snowbound
objectiveText: Deliver a Jar of Snow to Norric Lochthane at his house on the northwest coast of the Loch. Jar of Snow  ( 1 )

comments.body: Pick up the snow using the ceramic jar from anywhere near the South Gate at 19,66, you do not need to walk through the gate, that snow cannot be picked up. Turn into [npc=258043] at 41,18 standing just outside his house. As far as I know there is no longer a timer. I had no countdown and the jar had no duration.
You have 10 minutes to deliver the jar of snow once you fill it
replies: If you don't make it in time, you have to drop and reacquire the quest to get a new empty jar.
I guess this is changed now, I don't see a quest or quest item duration anywhere.
I don't see any duration on the quest item?

comments.body: No follow-up quests, which feels a bit odd
Location of the South Pass Snow is in Loch Modan BEFORE you enter the tunnel. Just click the bottle standing in the snow to either side of the entrance. See screenshot
